verdicts.reason: A shrinks the photo to an unreadable sliver at the far right, where the decorative squares sit on top of it. Leftover frame lines float empty on the left, and 'EDUCATING KIDS:' is tiny and wedged beside a two-line headline, so the key imagery is effectively lost. B keeps a cropped photo on the left and sets the headline as one strong line with the kicker above it. However, the decorative squares overlap the photo and crowd right up against the 'P', the photo is cramped into a small stub, and the kicker is very small, which still leaves it clearly unshippable.
